description: The multi-speaker pool of nn/multi.py - American English readers (LibriTTS-R train-clean-100 and dev-clean speakers classified "us" by nn/accent.py, and the labeled CMU ARCTIC US speakers): id is the training speaker index (build/nn/data/multi/index.json), hours are of the included utterances, medianF0 is Praat's over their voiced frames, and phoneMatch is the share of our front end's phones paired exactly (or AH/AX) with the corpus labels
